phases.name: t3-probe
phases.description: T3.5 remote-runner probe: echoes a marker whose stdout tail must ride the journal value (PF-2).

phases.name: t3-verify
phases.description: T3.5 closing sanity phase that exits cleanly.

phases.name: t3-marker
phases.description: T3.5 tracked work product: writes and COMMITS a marker file in the cloned checkout so the harvest bundle carries proof the phase executed on the box.
command: printf 't3 phase marker\n' > t3_phase_marker.txt && git add t3_phase_marker.txt && git -c user.name=t3-e2e -c user.email=t3-e2e@local commit -q -m t3-phase-marker
